seo.title: Dr. Arvinder Walia | Adult Psychiatrist in Austin, TX
seo.description: Meet Dr. Arvinder Walia, a board-certified adult psychiatrist with expertise in mood, anxiety, cognitive, forensic, and consultation-liaison psychiatry.

providers.specialty: Adult Psychiatry, Mood, Anxiety & Cognitive Disorders
providers.tagline: Care for adults with mood, anxiety and cognitive disorders, including psychiatric evaluations for medically complex concerns.
bioParagraphs: Dr. Arvinder Walia’s experience includes forensic evaluations of healthcare professionals and consultation-liaison psychiatry for patients with metabolic disorders.

He is co-founder and medical director of the Austin Center for Psychological Care, a dialectical behavior intensive outpatient program for personality and mood disorders. He also teaches Advanced Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner students at the University of Texas at Austin School of Nursing.

residency: Austin Medical Education Program for Psychiatry

hospitalAffiliations: St. David's North Austin Medical Center
academicAppointments: University of Texas at Austin School of Nursing

faqs.question: How do I schedule an appointment?
faqs.answer: Use the online scheduling link to book a new-patient or follow-up appointment, or call the office at (512) 342-7979 for help.

faqs.question: Do you accept insurance?
faqs.answer: We accept most traditional insurance plans. Participation varies by provider and plan, so call (512) 342-7979 to confirm coverage before your visit.

faqs.question: What should I complete before my first visit?
faqs.answer: Complete the new-patient forms before your appointment and allow at least 45 minutes to fill them out. If you are bringing printed paperwork, arrive 15 minutes early.

faqs.question: How do I access the patient portal?
faqs.answer: Established patients can use the Patient Portal link to access their Athenahealth account.

faqs.question: Are Friday appointments available in the office?
faqs.answer: Friday appointments are by telehealth only, from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Phone support is also available during those hours; there are no in-office appointments on Fridays.
